title: Wallet And Purchase Truth
rules: Revenue and paid value come from server purchase or ledger facts before client completion events.
Wallet UI must preserve paid-vs-reward GumDrop source truth.
PayPal checkout must use the canonical single-button wallet flow.

title: Drop Discovery And Unlock Truth
rules: Locked previews expose safe metadata only until entitlement truth exists.
Drop impressions require real exposure, not render-time spam.
Unlock counts come from server entitlement facts only.

title: Viewer File Tracking
rules: Every visible viewer file emits file_viewed with drop, file, media, and session ids.
File view telemetry must not include internal content URLs.
Viewer file views connect to watch session start/end facts.
blockedPatterns: watch session without viewer session id

title: Watch Time Truth
rules: Watch time is foreground visible engagement, not page duration.
Hidden, idle, offscreen, or modal-covered intervals do not count.
Behavioral intelligence prefers watch-session rollups over legacy duration fallbacks.
blockedPatterns: page duration as canonical watch time
raw content URL in watch payload

title: User Management Truth
rules: Admin user metrics read normalized user facts, not admin projection events.
User engagement and value exclude admin or owner-only activity.
Missing source truth must be shown as partial, stale, failed, or unknown.
blockedPatterns: admin QA counted as user behavior

title: Behavioral Intelligence Facts
rules: Raw events normalize into canonical event facts before scoring.
Deterministic ranking remains the safety baseline unless validation promotes ML.
Aliases must dedupe by user, entity, and time window.

title: Telemetry Actor And Target Truth
rules: Actor ids describe who performed the action; target ids describe the affected entity.
Client events support context unless server truth owns the metric.
Admin/projection events are excluded from user behavior.
blockedPatterns: creator_id mapped to actorCreatorId for fan action
admin projection included in user behavior

title: Support And Bug Report Truth
rules: User support actions appear in user timelines without admin pollution.
Bug reports include category, route, component, and severity.
Support permission errors feed debug evidence.
blockedPatterns: admin support reply counted as user behavior
flat support messages as canonical truth

title: Moderation Real Risk
rules: Screenshot-like signals are weak context unless server/platform confirmation exists.
Moderation decisions use evidence-weighted theft and scrape risk.
Raw asset URLs stay out of casual admin preview paths.
blockedPatterns: weak blur event as restriction reason
raw asset URL in admin moderation preview

title: Creator Dashboard And Experience Truth
rules: Creator paid experiences spend paid-source GumDrops only where required.
Expected booking and fan-pass failures return typed safe errors.
Admin projection cannot become live creator behavior.
blockedPatterns: generic internal server error for expected booking failure
projection write treated as live creator action

title: Admin Debug Control Tower
rules: Admin debug surfaces label live, cached, stale, fallback, partial, failed, or unknown truth.
Missing or stale data must not render healthy.
Heavy raw JSON stays collapsed behind operational summaries.
blockedPatterns: raw JSON as primary admin truth

title: AI Panel Runtime Truth
rules: AI model metadata comes from the shared registry.
Admin AI history remains canonical for prompt learning.
Create Drop local history clearing must not delete canonical AI jobs.
blockedPatterns: modal clear deletes server AI history

title: Device UI And Layout Contract
rules: Google owns structural breakpoints and viewport math; Apple owns cohesive shell styling.
Use shared device helpers instead of freestyle layout physics.
Device dry audits run before broad browser audits.

title: Image Loading And Content Safety
rules: Above-fold LCP images are eager sparingly; grids and rails are lazy.
Fill images require accurate sizes.
Locked previews never render internal content thumbnails before unlock.

title: Speed And Security Hardening
rules: API routes declare auth, origin, rate, idempotency, cache, cost, and failure contracts.
User/payment/support/chat/security routes stay no-store where needed.
Heavy browser audits are forbidden by default.

title: Google Cost Guardrails
rules: Google cost-bearing surfaces must be declared before use.
Data Connect remains an agent-context mirror unless explicitly promoted.
Provider jobs and deploy commands are documentation-only unless a human promotes them.

title: Legacy Phaseout Registry
rules: Legacy systems need owner, replacement, deadline, and allowed/blocked references.
Blocked legacy cannot re-enter canonical runtime paths.
Old systems cannot become canonical without registry update.
blockedPatterns: blocked legacy imported by canonical code
local projection treated as live behavior

title: Compact Agent Context
rules: Agents read doctrine.index.json first, then relevant JSONL cards, then source docs only when needed.
Append-only historical ledgers prefer JSONL.
Task packs include only relevant cards, validators, and legacy warnings.
blockedPatterns: loading every doctrine markdown by default
giant generated array as append-only ledger

title: Repo Governance Ledgers
rules: Verified runtime code outranks generated artifacts and chat.
Broad tooling work updates governance ledgers before signoff.
Generated context is a retrieval plane, not stronger truth.
